concerns.text: The plan relies on the HuggingFace dataset 'csabstruct' (URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/csabstruct/...) as a proxy for LSMS-ISA survey data. This dataset is a collection of abstracts from climate-smart agriculture literature, not a structured household survey containing variables like 'financial_access', 'HFIAS', or 'coordinates'. Using text abstracts to perform a multivariate regression on household yield stability is a fundamental dataset mismatch; the data modality (text vs. tabular survey) and content (literature summaries vs. field measurements) do not support the proposed analysis.

The mitigation strategy proposes generating a 'synthetic dataset' that 'structurally matches the schema' if real data is unavailable. While acceptable for unit testing, the plan frames this as a fallback for the 'Primary Path' of the research. A synthetic dataset cannot validate the research hypothesis regarding the correlation between CSA practices and yield stability in smallholder systems, as the correlations are artificially generated. The plan must explicitly distinguish between 'structural validation' (testing code logic) and 'scientific validation' (testing the hypothesis), and cannot claim the latter from synthetic data.
